on.description: Progress Reminders are on: a Claude session sideby starts that waits on background work tells the user every `every` minutes what it waits for (spec §3.42).

every.description: Minutes between reminders, config `progress.every`; absent while off.

choices.description: The intervals the Panel offers (status only).

families.description: Families whose sessions get reminders (status only); Codex has no hook that can wake a session.

changed.description: on and off: whether the config changed.

before.description: on and off: the interval before, when it was on.

undo.description: on and off: the command that puts back what was there.

message.description: on and off: one line for the user.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
